description: This file defines an abstract class AbstractFixture in the namespace OrangeHRM\Tests\Util\Fixture; it provides utility methods for handling test fixtures in the OrangeHRM project, such as dumping data to YAML files and accessing entity managers.

classes.name: AbstractFixture
classes.description: An abstract base class providing utilities for test fixture management such as dumping data into YAML files and providing access to database entity managers.

methods.name: getTextHelperService
methods.description: Returns an instance of TextHelperService, initializes it if not already set.

methods.name: dumpFixture
methods.description: Dumps fixture content to a YAML file in the test fixtures directory, throws an exception if connected to an invalid database.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve fixture content as an array, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: getFileName
methods.description: Abstract static method to retrieve the filename for the fixture, to be implemented by subclasses.
